"Asked if an ejected player leaving the stadium was commonplace, one former teammate said he had never seen it happen before in his life."

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, August 25, 2017 9:56 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Add
Neither Martinez nor Verlander have spoken about Thursday’s exchange and according to manager Brad Ausmus, two were playing cards on the team flight to Chicago later that night.
“We’ll just see how it goes going forward,” Ausmus said. “There’s a lot of emotions. Sometimes, those emotions spill over when you’re in the dugout. I’m not worried about it.”

The exchange appeared to be initiated because Martinez played peacemaker during the on-field fracas in the seventh inning with Yankees catcher Gary Sanchez – who threw punches at both Castellanos and first baseman Miguel Cabrera in the sixth inning – and righty reliever Dellin Betances, who had just hit catcher James McCann in the head with a fastball.
Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
